enforcedEnabled.title: Lock link checking on or off
enforcedEnabled.description: true keeps link checking (and blocking) on for every user; false keeps it off. Leave unset to let users decide.

allowUserBlocklist.title: Allow users' own blocklist
allowUserBlocklist.description: false ignores entries users added themselves and stops them from adding or importing entries, so only enforcedBlocklist applies. Default: true.

enforcedBlocklist.title: Blocklist entries enforced for all users
enforcedBlocklist.description: Entries users cannot remove. type is domain, url, wildcard or regex; value as in the options page; note is shown to the user.
